messages:
Ana Gomez: Quick UX thing from today's console pass: primary CTA in the dense table header looks visually misaligned with the icon button to its right at 1366px. Feels like baseline shift.
Kai Thompson: interesting, is this the new compact header layout? I can check in staging.
Ana Gomez: yes, compact header + small buttons. Screenshot uploaded to the thread.
Priya Desai: my hunch is we scaled the button icon but not the vertical centering token. We have `--button-icon-16` for size but missing `--button-vertical-offset-compact`.
Ethan Wu: current CSS excerpt: ```css
.header .btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; }
.header .btn-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
```
Ethan Wu: when icon size reduces we should center with `line-height` or use flex align center. Might be a text baseline vs icon baseline mismatch.
Ana Gomez: Proposal: add a small centering token `--control-vertical-center-compact: 2px` and apply it to icon-only buttons in compact headers, or use flexbox for explicit centering.
Kai Thompson: prefer flexbox so we don't need lots of tiny offset tokens. Example: `.btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }` keeps icon centered regardless of font metrics.
Priya Desai: agree but still think a token for consistent vertical rhythm is useful across components (headers, modals, table cells). We could add `--rhythm-compact-ctrl: 4px` and use it for top/bottom padding.
design-bot: lint: token "--rhythm-compact-ctrl" not found in tokens.json. Recommend adding token if used (lint-id: spacing-19912).
Ethan Wu: another related issue: compact modals on the dashboard sometimes push the table header up so the sticky row overlaps the modal footer when both are visible. Toasts compound the problem by stacking at the same z-index.
Ana Gomez: Hmm. We should ensure modals are above shell elements and toast stacking respects z-index hierarchy. Also avoid sticky headers overlapping modal backdrops.
Kai Thompson: Plan: 1) use flexbox centering for icon buttons to fix baseline; 2) add a single `--rhythm-compact-ctrl` token for spacing consistency (if team wants explicit token); 3) audit z-index tokens: `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`, `--z-sticky` to ensure modal > toast > sticky.
Priya Desai: accessibility nit: icon-only primary buttons need visible focus ring at 2px and not be clipped by overflow:hidden on header container. Add `outline-offset: 2px` and set container overflow visible.
Ethan Wu: I'll take the z-index and stacking changes, and set `.app-shell { overflow: visible; }` where needed for focus rings. I'll add visual diffs. Assigning to @Ethan Wu.
Ana Gomez: I'll do the button centering change and propose token in tokens.yml. I'll include before/after screenshots and a short note in the component docs about using flex centering vs offsets.
Kai Thompson: don't forget to run cross-browser check for Firefox baseline oddities.
design-bot: automated check: missing token suggestion noted and focus ring clipping detected in 1 component. See lint report.
Priya Desai: PR checklist addition: include keyboard-only navigation test on dense header, ensure tab stops go to icon button and primary action in expected order. Also voiceover check for focus ring visibility.
Ethan Wu: Toast/modal z-index PR opened, visual diffs uploaded. Using `--z-modal: 9000`, `--z-toast: 8500`, `--z-sticky: 8000`.
Ana Gomez: Button centering PR opened with flexbox change and optional `--rhythm-compact-ctrl: 4px` token. Staging link included.
Kai Thompson: Reviewed both PRs and left minor comment about a legacy selector. Ran Firefox checks 70 and baseline looks good.
Priya Desai: Spot-checked a11y on iPad and VoiceOver 1. Focus ring is visible, tab order correct.
Ana Gomez: Merged after addressing comments. Ethan, feel free to merge once CI green for z-index PR.
Ethan Wu: CI green, merged. Verified on staging. Looks tidy across widths.
Ana Gomez: Thanks team 389 Closing thread.
